# wikijs_api_key (Resource)

The `wikijs_api_key` Resource implements the Wiki.JS API mutations `authentication{createApiKey{…}}` and `authentication{revokeApiKey{…}}`.
It can be used to create and destroy API keys and also ensure that API keys are always valid.
For that you need to define the `min_remaining_duration` that Terraform can see that it needs to renew/create a new API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an API key that is valid for 30 days with full access/admin
# access

resource "wikijs_api_key" "admin_key" {
  expires_in  = "30d"
  name        = "Wiki.JS Adminkey"
  full_access = true
}

# Create an API key that only allows group 3 level access that is one
# year old

resource "wikijs_api_key" "group_key" {
  expires_in = "1y"
  name       = "Wiki.JS Grouplevelkey"
  group_id   = "3"
}

# Create an API key that gets renewed/recreated through terraform a
# month prior to expiration

resource "wikijs_api_key" "renewed_key" {
	expires_in = "1y"
	name = "Wiki.JS Renewing Key"
	full_access = true
	min_remaining_duration = "1m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires_in` (String) When creating an API key wiki.JS expects an expiration timespan (e.g. '30d', '20h').
- `name` (String) Display name of the API key.
  Does not need to unique.

### Optional

- `full_access` (Boolean) Set to true to create an API key with full access rights (admin).
  It is mutually exclusive with the `group_id`.
- `group_id` (Number) Integer of `group_id` the API key should inherit the permissions and page rules from. 
  It is mutually exclusive with `full_access`.
- `min_remaining_duration` (String) Set a minimum duration the API key need to remain active.
  This field is changed when the expiration date come to close and triggers a replace.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time as returned by Wiki.JS.
  Expect RFC3339 as format.
- `expiration` (String) The actual expiration date of this key.
- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the API Key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The actual API key.
  Keep this SECRET!
- `key_short` (String) Suffix of the actual API key as shown in the Web UI. 

  Hint: Wiki.JS always adds three dots before the suffix.
  You need to remove them to programatically reuse the key.
